text:
maya: quick q — current spec says when Dedicated pool rejects request due to capacity we fall back to hosted. Is that acceptable for Dedicated tenants with egress/data residency restrictions? cc @sam

sam: short answer: not for Private. For Dedicated we need a clear policy, otherwise legal will veto.

jordan: earlier doc used 'spillover' language. propose a 'roaming handshake' instead: prefer same-region hosted variant, strip tenant identifiers, and log audit entries. rough config sketch:

```json
{"policy":"roam-to-hosted","strip_headers":["x-tenant-id"],"region_preference":["eu-west-1","us-east-1"],"model_fallback":"quantized-compatible"}
```

maya: stripping tenant id is okay for PII, but metadata + payload may still leak residency signals — legal will push back.

henry: legal: any routing that moves requests off-customer network must be opt-in for accounts with egress or residency controls. we need explicit admin consent + audit trail.

sam: operationally we can also try cross-region Dedicated fallback (other Dedicated pool) before hosted. Cheaper for compliance but slower to provision and may violate tenant isolation if it's shared.

priya: from Console/UX POV we'll need a toggle and clear wording. Suggest copy: "Allow Redwood hosted fallback when Dedicated capacity is exhausted. This may route data through Redwood hosted infrastructure and change residency."

jordan: telemetry needs: per-request tags -> origin_pool, routed_pool, model_variant, latency_ms, roam_flag. Also surface counts in per-tenant dashboard for audit.

infra-bot: deploy job started for branch 'roaming-handshake-qos' — status: success ✅

maya: proposed decision: roaming fallback OFF by default for Dedicated tenants marked with egress/residency restrictions; allow admin opt-in; require console flag + API opt-in header; always produce audit logs. any objections?

sam: +1 but we should also add an enforced 429 path if no Dedicated capacity and no opt-in, rather than silently queuing. add quota impact warning in console.

priya: I'll mock the toggle and modal, include sample audit table. modal copy: "Enable hosted fallback (recommended for availability). Turning this on may route requests to Redwood hosted endpoints."

henry: add SLA note in docs: fallbacks are best-effort and won't preserve Dedicated latency SLOs or guaranteed throughput. mention retention of logs for audits.

jordan: runtime implementation notes: add API param `x-roam-allowed: true` or default absent; add sidecar that strips headers if tenant opts-in; attach telemetry header `x-routing:origin=dedicated;dest=hosted;variant=quant-q4`.

maya: action items: open RFC with owners — @priya handle UX, @sam infra for cross-region fallback, @jordan runtime + telemetry, legal consult @henry. I'll start RFC tonight.

priya: assigning mock + copy tasks.

maya: thanks all, will file RFC and link back here. closing thread
